product: Taiwan Company Registry — Clean English JSON (GCIS / MOEA)
kind: VALIDATION SAMPLE — 100 records, not for sale; built to decide P01 vs P02

coverage.sample: First 100 rows of the September 2026 monthly file, in file order (NOT a random sample; geographic skew noted below)
address_notes: source floor range '8樓之6至8樓之8' (units 6-8 on floor 8)

method.dates: ROC (Minguo) dates converted by +1911, output ISO 8601 (e.g. 1150911 -> 2026-09-11).
method.addresses: Chinese address parsed into structured fields (county/city, district, village, road, section, lane, alley, number, floor, room) and transliterated to Hanyu Pinyin with standard English names for counties/cities and for North/South/East/West/Central districts; road suffixes Rd./St./Blvd., directional suffixes S./N./E./W., Chinese road numerals as ordinals (e.g. 五街 -> 5th St.). Village (里) kept as a structured field, omitted from the formatted postal string. No postal code in source.
method.business_items: Enriched per company from GCIS Application Three API (dataset 22198, OGDL). Each standard code translated with a hand-built glossary (338 entries covering 100% of the descriptions in this sample); '(限區外經營)' rendered as '(outside-zone operations only)'. Free-text scopes (no standard code) are NOT translated: name_en is null with a note.
method.company_name_en: Always null in this sample: the GCIS register does not publish confirmed English names and the register does not require one. An English name must never be invented.
method.representative_name: Excluded by default (personal data under Taiwan PDPA; the waisuan precedent keeps representative names off by default). The source file does contain the representative's name; it is available as an opt-in field, not in this sample.
method.attribution: OGDL-Taiwan-1.0 requires attribution (agency + year + dataset + licence URL) in every record/output; embedded in each record's source block. Failure to attribute voids the licence.

price_framing: Pay-per-result. Internal floor US$0.05 per lookup (never below); proposed band US$0.05-0.10 per lookup. This sample itself is a free validation artefact, not a priced product.
